title: Utility Order for Atmos Energy Corporation, ex parte. — Order No. U-37887 accepts the Joint Report for the 2025 Test Year Rate Stabilization Plan filing submitted on July 23, 2026, which states that an increase in rates for a net revenue increase of $33,796,020 is necessary and in accordance with the terms of Atmos Energy Corporation’s Rate Stabilization Clause. This matter was considered at the August 12, 2026 Business and Executive Session.
